description: This file defines function types, function declarations, and utility helpers for implementing built-in functions within a build system or scripting environment, specifically related to GN (Generate Ninja) build system. It includes function signatures for executing various build-related commands and managing scope and block structures.

classes.name: FunctionInfo
classes.description: Structure representing information about a built-in function, including its execution type, help texts, and whether it is a target function.

classes.name: NonNestableBlock
classes.description: Helper class to enforce non-nestable block constraints within scope during build script parsing.

methods.name: GetFunctions
methods.description: Returns a map of all built-in functions available in the system.

methods.name: RunFunction
methods.description: Executes a specified function with given arguments and context.

methods.name: EnsureNotReadingFromSameDeclareArgs
methods.description: Validates that a value is not being read from the same declare_args scope.

methods.name: EnsureNotProcessingImport
methods.description: Checks that the current scope is not processing an import.

methods.name: EnsureNotProcessingBuildConfig
methods.description: Checks that the current scope is not processing a build configuration.

methods.name: FillTargetBlockScope
methods.description: Prepares the scope for executing a target-related block, setting defaults and target name.

methods.name: FillNeedsBlockError
methods.description: Sets an error indicating that a function call requires a block.

methods.name: EnsureSingleStringArg
methods.description: Validates that a function call has exactly one string argument.

methods.name: ToolchainLabelForScope
methods.description: Retrieves the toolchain label associated with a scope.

methods.name: MakeLabelForScope
methods.description: Creates a label based on scope, function, and name.

methods.name: NonNestableBlock::Enter
methods.description: Attempts to enter a non-nestable block, returning false if nesting is not allowed.
